companyDomain.title: Company domain
companyDomain.description: The company to analyze, as a bare domain. Its competitors are read from its own alternatives page.

maxCompetitors.title: Maximum competitors
maxCompetitors.description: How many competitors to read. When an alternatives page names more than this, the set is cut in a fixed alphabetical order so the same page always yields the same competitors — a low number therefore drops real competitors arbitrarily. 20 is a sensible floor. Changing this makes the next run a fresh baseline rather than a NEW/SEEN diff.

competitors.title: Competitors
competitors.description: Optional. Explicit competitor domains, as bare domains such as "rival.com". When set, these are used instead of asking the model to name competitors. Changing this list makes the next run a fresh baseline rather than a NEW/SEEN diff, because it changes what the run looks at.

directories.title: Integration directories
directories.description: Large directories to harvest names from. Leave empty to use the seven verified defaults shown here; override to target a different ecosystem. Changing this list makes the next run a fresh baseline rather than a NEW/SEEN diff, because it changes what the run looks at.

minSources.title: Minimum sources per candidate
minSources.description: Only report a name carried by at least this many sources. Raise it to cut noise.
